subject.title: refactor(agents): make API registry ownership lifecycle-local

question: Should late registrations through the shipped Plugin SDK facade continue to reach already-active model-registry lifecycles?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes ownership, but the choice between live compatibility publication and a newly explicit refresh contract affects external plugin behavior and cannot safely be inferred from this refactor alone.

options.title: Preserve live SDK publication
options.body: Fan out newly published facade providers into active lifecycle registries while keeping session-local registrations isolated.

options.title: Adopt an explicit refresh contract
options.body: Require a documented lifecycle refresh after SDK registration only if maintainers intentionally accept the external-plugin compatibility break and provide an upgrade path.

options.title: Pause the refactor
options.body: Hold the PR until the permanent Plugin SDK/provider lifecycle contract is agreed and covered by a regression test.

recommendation.title: Preserve live SDK publication
recommendation.body: Fan out newly published facade providers into active lifecycle registries while keeping session-local registrations isolated.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the proposed lifecycle-ownership boundary and its compatibility facade handling.
